messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: Elevated 5xx rate for tenant PolarisBank in dedicated pool polaris-ded-3. >70% of requests hitting model 13b-v1.2 are erroring. Paging on-call. Pager: https://pager.redwood.example/INC-20260312-001

alex_g: I’m on it, grabbing logs and env. ETA 5m.

sara_r: any idea if PolarisBank is in a VPC subnet that might be affecting egress to KV cache? or is this strictly model kernel failures?

incident-bot: Metric snapshot (last 5m): 
- 5xx rate tenant=polarisbank: 18% (baseline 0.6%)
- p50 latency: 220ms -> 350ms
- pool polaris-ded-3 GPU util: 93%

jin: seeing repeated kernel SIGSEGV in the 13b attention path in recent host logs. suspect a kernel combo + long-seq workload. Might be a regression in the quantized kernel roll.

alex_g: copying logs here:
```
[2026-03-12T08:22:14Z] polaris-ded-3-node07 kernel: oops: 0000 [#1] SMP
[2026-03-12T08:22:14Z] redwood-runtime: model=13b-v1.2 tenant=polarisbank seq=512 err=KV_MMAP_FAIL
```

dba_tess: PolarisBank just pushed a big batch of long-context requests (>=4k tokens) at 08:20; that could bump mem and expose a kernel regression.

jin: mitigation plan: 1) pin PolarisBank to a safe variant (polaris-safe-v1) that uses older, validated kernels; 2) if needed, route 100% traffic to a warm fallback pool; 3) open dedicated rollback for the kernel release.

sara_r: agree. prefer gradual traffic-shift first (canary) then full pin if stable. also disable KV cache for tenant while we validate.

alex_g: executing canary -> 25% to safe variant and disable kv for tenant.

alex_g: running command:
```
redwoodctl traffic-shift --tenant polarisbank --from=13b-v1.2 --to=polaris-safe-v1 --percent=25 --reason "canary fallback after kernel errors"
redwoodctl tenant-config set --tenant polarisbank --kv-cache enabled=false --reason "isolate until kernel rollback"
```

incident-bot: Action recorded by alex_g. Jobs queued: traffic-shift(25%), tenant-config(kv-cache=false).

csm_oliver: I’ll ping PolarisBank support now (status page + CSM thread). Notifying customer that we’re routing a portion of traffic to a safe variant; we’ll update within 20m.

(six minutes later)

incident-bot: Update: canary applied. 5xx rate tenant=polarisbank -> 6.3% (was 18%). p50 latency improved to 270ms.

jin: good signal. keep canary for 15m; if errors remain <2% expand to 100% and re-enable KV with tighter limits.

sara_r: preparing full pin command if green. Also opening an emergency rollback PR on the kernel repo so infra can revert the problematic kernels on polaris-ded-3 nodes.

alex_g: shard health check shows node07 still has OOM traces, but overall pool stable. Proceeding to 100% traffic shift in 8m if numbers hold.

(ten minutes later)

incident-bot: Canary -> success. 5xx now 1.8% tenant=polarisbank. Initiating full pin to polaris-safe-v1.

alex_g: running full pin + note to expire override in 24h: 
```
redwoodctl tenants override --tenant polarisbank --model polaris-safe-v1 --scope tenant --reason "mitigate kernel regression" --expires 2026-03-13T08:22:00Z
redwoodctl tenant-config set --tenant polarisbank --kv-cache enabled=true --ttl=300s --reason "re-enable with conservative ttl"
```

incident-bot: Overrides applied. Traffic 100% -> polaris-safe-v1. KV cache re-enabled with ttl=300s.

csm_oliver: Customer update sent: polite note, said we mitigated and are working on root cause. PolarisBank worried about degraded throughput but accepts fallback.

oncall-ops: handing off to night oncall @alex_g in 15m. Summary for handoff: POLARISBANK — pinned to polaris-safe-v1 due to kernel SIGSEGV on 13b-v1.2. Canary succeeded. KV cache re-enabled with ttl=300s. Follow-ups: rollback kernel PR, run long-context regression suite, confirm no other tenants hit. Links: incident runbook https://runbooks.redwood/internal/inc-20260312-001

alex_g: I’ll monitor overnight and escalate if any regression. Leaving a note for SRE morning triage to validate dedicated pool node replacements and kernel revert schedule.

sara_r: Post-incident tasks (quick):
- revert kernel release on polaris-ded-3 (infra)
- regression test long-context workloads against 13b-v1.2 (ml)
- review autoscaler thresholds for dedicated pools (platform)
- confirm tenant override expiration and add permanent policy if customer requests long-term pin

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> Monitored. Severity reduced to Sev-2. Adding doc: "polarisbank-fallback-20260312" to incidents index.

csm_oliver: will schedule a customer call tomorrow AM to discuss SLAs and long-term options (dedicated rollback vs safe-variant support).

oncall-ops: handoff complete. :white_check_mark:

alex_g: thanks team.
